note: Extension layer for the brief renderer. The shared design-scaffold token schema fixes `colors` to 15 keys with additionalProperties:false, so the dark code surface this skill needs cannot live in .design/tokens.json. Keys are CSS custom property names on purpose: this is the distribution layer, not the authoring layer, and the renderer emits them verbatim after tokens.css.
promote_when: A second UI-producing skill needs the same code-surface colors. At that point this becomes a fixture-backed extension of the shared schema instead of a private layer.
